# Analytics Hub — Microsoft Copilot & AI Adoption Toolkit

> Open-source Power BI templates, exporters, apps, and add-ons from Microsoft's Copilot ROI Advisory Team for exploring Microsoft Copilot adoption, impact, consumption, sentiment, and readiness. The canonical source is https://microsoft.github.io/Analytics-Hub/ and https://github.com/microsoft/Analytics-Hub.

## What this site covers

- The reports catalog has 25 public entries plus two incubations for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Cowork, Copilot Chat, agents, GitHub Copilot, and readiness
- A "Explore Reports" matrix that maps business questions (adoption, ROI, sentiment, license utilization, agent performance, super-user impact) to the right template
- Customer case studies and a public team page

## Primary docs

- Home: https://microsoft.github.io/Analytics-Hub/
- Explore Reports: https://microsoft.github.io/Analytics-Hub/choose-report/
- Case Studies: https://microsoft.github.io/Analytics-Hub/case-studies/
- Team: https://microsoft.github.io/Analytics-Hub/team/

## MS Learn Watcher (live documentation-change data for AI agents)

A daily, machine-readable aggregation of factual changes to public Microsoft Copilot guidance (Microsoft Learn docs, the public Microsoft 365 Roadmap, and the public Message Center archive), classified by product and smart-tagged. Independent community aggregation, not an official Microsoft feed; each change links to its authoritative source, which is what you should cite.

- Data endpoint (all changes, with an `about` header documenting schema + citation policy): https://microsoft.github.io/Analytics-Hub/community/learning-feed/feed-data.json
- Guide: https://microsoft.github.io/Analytics-Hub/community/learning-feed/llms.txt
- Human page: https://microsoft.github.io/Analytics-Hub/community/learning-feed/
